objective: Run a Japanese-vs-English NVFP4 W4A4 calibration language sensitivity pilot for LLM accuracy.
summary: English/Japanese language datasets were generated, three NVFP4 W4A4 Qwen3-4B variants were produced, and held-out English/Japanese NLL evaluation completed. All quantized variants were worse than base; English calibration won on English eval, bilingual mixed won on Japanese eval.

agent_runs.notes: Generated language datasets, quantized three variants, and evaluated NLL.
Interpretation updated with language NLL matrix.

next_actions: Increase evaluation size beyond 24 examples per language.
Use more parallel English/Japanese evaluation data.
Repeat quantization with 128 or 256 calibration samples.
Add generation accuracy if needed, using vLLM only as an execution backend if Transformers generation is impractically slow.
